metadata.description: Report-writing skills for federal-court compliance monitoring under a consent decree

plugins.name: hibiscus-reporting
plugins.description: Court-report drafting skills for the Hibiscus monitoring team, governed by the monitor's cumulative rulebook (kate-rules.md): observation inventory + coverage map, paragraph-ordered section drafting (one block per consent-decree paragraph, with NO EVIDENCE placeholders), executive summary writing, baseline comparison, voice checking, observation lookup, Google Docs formatting prep, and cross-session handoff. v5.0 bakes in the monitor's standing rules (no unit names, month/year only, DVA, concerns-first ordering, generalized meds/labs, banned phrases) and reverses the old credit-first paragraph ordering to concerns-first/positives-last.
